nodes.label: Local Copy Moat (store cover and text on device)
nodes.norm_label: local copy moat (store cover and text on device)
nodes.rationale: Link-only bookmarks go empty when authors delete posts, ghost posts expire in 24h, and Meta CDN URLs expire; saving original cover and text locally at save time is the product's key differentiator.

nodes.label: APK Signing Strategy
nodes.rationale: APKs are signed with the Expo template debug key so new versions install over old ones; the workflow verifies the key is unchanged. Custom keys via ANDROID_KEYSTORE_* secrets require uninstalling once.

nodes.label: Apple Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Immediate press feedback, critically damped springs, single primary action, always-visible state, haptics only on success/failure, respect system dark mode and reduce-motion.

nodes.label: Semantic Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Components must use semantic names, never hardcoded hex; dark mode is separately tuned warm grey, not inverted

nodes.label: Text-color-with-surface pairing rule
nodes.rationale: Previous preview paired dark tag background with dark text and became invisible

nodes.label: ImprintMono Date Imprint Font
nodes.rationale: Subset of IBM Plex Mono Medium keeping only digits and date punctuation; renamed ImprintMono because a subset is a Modified Version under OFL and Plex is a Reserved Font Name.

nodes.label: LXGW WenKai TC Subset Font
nodes.rationale: Subset to ASCII/Latin-1, punctuation and Big5 level-1 (6,929 code points) with pyftsubset to keep the APK small (~4 MB per weight instead of ~13 MB); missing glyphs fall back to the system font.

nodes.label: Subtle Handwritten Font Choice (WenKai TC)
nodes.rationale: User wanted a slight handwritten feel that isn't obvious; LXGW WenKai TC (OFL) was chosen for titles and post text.

nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation
nodes.rationale: ios/ and android/ are generated; never edit by hand, configure via app.json and config plugins.

nodes.label: Use Versioned Expo Docs, Not Training Data
nodes.norm_label: use versioned expo docs, not training data
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release, so agents must read the expo major version and fetch matching versioned docs or llms.txt instead of relying on memory.

nodes.label: Defer Expo Router Migration
nodes.rationale: Expo Router is the project convention but was not adopted this round to avoid risk to the share flow.

nodes.label: NoteBlock / NoteSection / NoteSheet / NoteField
nodes.rationale: Notes in sans body so user's own words are distinct from author's WenKai text

nodes.norm_label: local sqlite storage (expo-sqlite, two-level tags via parentid)

nodes.label: Auto-tag Rules (tag_rules table, tagRules.js)
nodes.rationale: Rules only add tags on first successful fetch, written in the same update as content so the sheet never shows an intermediate state

nodes.label: Smart Tag Suggestions
nodes.rationale: Suggest only, never auto-check: suggestions arrive after fetch and would change state under the finger

nodes.label: Motion Spring Tokens (press/standard/sheet/stagger, src/ui/motion.js)
nodes.rationale: Animate only transform/opacity; reduced motion keeps 150ms fades; all animations interruptible

nodes.label: Full Save Sheet (fixed 88% height)
nodes.rationale: Post is already saved when sheet appears; title says 已收藏; closing keeps it in 未分類

nodes.label: lockPicks / SETTLE_MS 1.5s
nodes.rationale: Trade-off: waiting too long slows one-tap save; not waiting loses same-author signal; buttons locked once drawn

nodes.label: PressScale containerStyle rule
nodes.rationale: Layout styles must live on the pressable itself; prototype FAB had a 0x0 hit area on Android

nodes.label: Undo-instead-of-confirm Delete Pattern
nodes.rationale: Single deletes show 5s undo toast; only tag deletion (affects many cards) confirms

nodes.label: Featured Card (full-row)
nodes.rationale: Aspect ratio 0.5–0.75 (0.3–0.45 in 3-col) so a single landscape image does not fill the screen

nodes.label: Hidden WebView with User Login
nodes.rationale: Logged-out Threads pages contain no media data, so the app opens posts in a hidden WebView using the user's own login; login state stays on the phone and no backend server or API key is needed.
